changelog: Facility colour themes — pick your brand colour in Admin → Facility → Appearance (six, including Salvation Army). Applies across the whole interface for every user.
Weekend passes reworked — Approved / Active / Returned, with Mark Departed (unlocks 10 minutes before departure), Mark Returned, and Extend, which records who moved the return and from what.
Editable resident statuses — rename, recolour, add or retire them in Admin → Facility → Statuses.
Modals restyled to match the rest of the app and follow the selected theme.
Fixed: the Clinical sidebar stayed light-coloured in dark mode.
Fixed: form fields in dark-mode dialogs had no contrast against the panel behind them.
Security: the release signing key was rotated. Installing this build is required before any later update will verify.
